_readme: Entries of docs/FINNISH_REVIEW.md checked against English Wiktionary (read through kaikki.org, its machine-readable copy), October 2026. Each one is short enough for a dictionary to settle: a single word or form, a list of forms, a letter name, a "Do you…?" question (the verb's 2nd person present + -ko/-kö), or a short title, label, lesson quote or sentence pattern whose every word is a Wiktionary form in the grammar used, built the plain textbook way. "fi" is the Finnish as it read when checked: if it changes, the entry goes back to "to check". "how" is the evidence. Longer text — stories, scenes, the forms marked wrong, the wrong replies, made-up compounds — is left to the native reviewer, and so is anything a dictionary can't settle ("notes" says why for those). A native reviewer's decision always wins over this file.
